users.title: Users
users.subtitle: Staff accounts, their roles and which branches they can work in.
users.searchPlaceholder: Search name, username, email or phone
users.emptyText: Create accounts for your laboratory staff and give each the roles they need.
users.usernameHint: Used to sign in. Lowercase letters, numbers, dot, dash or underscore.
users.designationHint: Shown on reports for signatories, e.g. Consultant Pathologist.
users.initialPasswordHint: Share it with the user privately. They must change it at first sign-in.
users.rolesHint: Permissions come from roles. A user can have several.
users.allBranchesHint: Includes branches added in future, and the all-branches view.
users.activeHint: Inactive users can't sign in. Their history is kept.

users.resetDoneText: Give the temporary password to {{name}} in person.

rolesPage.title: Roles & permissions
rolesPage.subtitle: Roles bundle permissions. Changes apply to signed-in users within two minutes.
rolesPage.selectRole: Select a role to view or edit its permissions.
rolesPage.activeHint: Users keep the role, but an inactive role grants no permissions.
rolesPage.deleteText: This can't be undone. Built-in roles and roles assigned to users can't be deleted.
rolesPage.clinicalNote: Clinical approval permissions should only be given to qualified laboratory professionals.

org.title: Branches & departments
org.subtitle: Your organisation, its branches and laboratory departments.
org.branchActiveHint: Inactive branches are hidden from selection. Their records are kept.
org.emptyDepartmentsText: Departments group tests and worklists, e.g. Haematology or Chemistry.

patients.subtitle: Search by registration number, name, mobile or CNIC. A barcode scanner works in the search box.
patients.searchPlaceholder: Patient no., name, mobile or CNIC
patients.emptyText: Register your first patient to start taking orders.
patients.ageHint: Age decides which reference ranges apply, so it is required.
patients.hiddenSensitive: Identity details are hidden for your role.

patients.ordersEmptyText: Lab orders and reports for this patient will appear here once ordering is available (Phase 6).

doctors.title: Doctors
doctors.subtitle: Referring doctors and in-house consultants.
doctors.searchPlaceholder: Name, code, hospital, phone or PMDC no.
doctors.inHouseHint: Works at the laboratory rather than referring from outside.
doctors.emptyText: Add the doctors who refer patients to your laboratory.

catalog.testsSubtitle: Orderable tests, their parameters, prices and approved reference ranges.
catalog.searchTests: Search code, name or short name
catalog.emptyText: Create categories first, then add tests with their parameters.
catalog.shortNameHint: Used on worklists and labels, e.g. CBC.
catalog.priceLocked: Prices can only be changed by users with the price management permission.
catalog.parametersHint: Each value reported for this test. Order controls the report layout.
catalog.decimalsHint: Digits shown on reports. Entered values are stored exactly.
catalog.optionsHint: Tick values that should be flagged as abnormal — clinical configuration.
catalog.noParamsText: Add the values this test reports, e.g. Haemoglobin, WBC.
catalog.rangesIntro: Only approved ranges are used to flag results. Approved ranges can't be edited: add a draft that replaces it.
catalog.clinicalWarning: Reference ranges must come from a validated source (kit insert, guideline or local study) and be approved by a qualified professional.
catalog.ageToHint: Leave empty for no upper limit.
catalog.criticalHint: Results beyond critical limits trigger an urgent alert.
catalog.displayTextHint: Optional for numbers (e.g. "< 200"); required for text results (e.g. "Negative").
catalog.sourceHint: Where the range comes from, e.g. kit insert lot, guideline or local verification study. Required for approval.
catalog.approveText: Once approved it will be used to flag patient results. Make sure the limits and source are correct.
catalog.retireText: Results will no longer be flagged with this range. Add an approved replacement if one is needed.
catalog.queueSubtitle: Review each draft against its source before approving.
catalog.queueEmptyText: Draft ranges created in the test catalog will appear here.
catalog.categoriesSubtitle: Group tests on order screens and reports.
catalog.categoriesEmptyText: Create categories such as Haematology, Biochemistry or Serology.
catalog.packagesSubtitle: Bundles of tests offered at a combined price.
catalog.packagesEmptyText: Combine tests into packages such as a health check-up.

orders.notesHint: Optional, e.g. fasting status or provisional diagnosis.

payments.search: Receipt, order, invoice or patient no.
